title: Ember — a nine-course tasting menu in Ghent
description: Ember is a sixteen-seat tasting-menu restaurant in Ghent: one seating a night, nine courses built around the morning's market. Reserve a table.

outline.heading: A nine-course story, one table a night.
outline.text: Ember builds its tasting menu each morning around what the North Sea and nearby Flemish farms bring in — one seating, sixteen seats, every evening.
items: Heritage tomato, burrata, basil seed oil
North Sea turbot, brown shrimp, sea aster

outline.heading: Tonight's tasting menu
outline.text: Nine courses, changed with the market. Wine pairing +€65, non-alcoholic pairing +€65.
items: Charred sourdough, cultured butter, beef fat
Heritage tomato, burrata, basil seed oil
North Sea turbot, brown shrimp, sea aster
Dry-aged Flemish beef, bone marrow, girolles
